capabilities.name: Read-only repository inspection
capabilities.description: Collect current repository evidence: branch state, commits, worktrees, open PRs, and file snapshots without mutation.

capabilities.name: PR comparison and collision inspection
capabilities.description: Compare open pull requests to current main, identify shared surfaces, and rank merge or rebuild paths.

capabilities.name: Validator selection
capabilities.description: Choose validators from the registry based on changed paths, workflow, and proof ceiling. Does not invent validation results.

capabilities.name: Deployment candidate assembly
capabilities.description: Build a controlled deployment candidate from current main by converging owned, non-conflicting changes. Requires explicit authorization for live surfaces.

capabilities.name: Local production certification
capabilities.description: Run a disposable local production-mode certification against a candidate SHA, then emit GO/NO-GO with bounded evidence.

capabilities.name: Runtime-proof recording
capabilities.description: Record sanitized commands, timestamps, assertions, failures, and attained proof levels in the runtime-proof schema.
